processes:task-eo-improve-intake-cjvh26.plain_language_name: Receive the Performance Evidence and Programme Mandate
processes:task-eo-improve-intake-cjvh26.plain_language_description: Selection opens when the performance evidence and the programme mandate are handed over together as the ground the project choices will be made from. The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the selection from a recorded base.
processes:task-eo-improve-intake-cjvh26.business_purpose: It exists so projects are chosen from registered evidence under a registered mandate rather than from whoever asks loudest.
processes:task-eo-improve-intake-cjvh26.practical_context: It opens when the evidence and mandate are presented for the selection, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the performance evidence and programme mandate as the selection baseline, with audit references, and opens the choosing work.

processes:task-eo-improve-transform-w54h.plain_language_name: Choose the Projects the Programme Will Run
processes:task-eo-improve-transform-w54h.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian does the selection itself: the waste and variation in the evidence are read into a bounded set of projects, and the selected project portfolio is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-improve-transform-w54h.business_purpose: It exists because improvement effort is finite - selection is what aims it at the waste that matters most.
processes:task-eo-improve-transform-w54h.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be chosen from, and it ends with the selected portfolio produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the operations function reads the evidence for waste and variation and sets down the bounded portfolio, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-improve-verify-unpyvj.plain_language_name: Check the Evidence Before Choosing the Projects
processes:task-eo-improve-verify-unpyvj.plain_language_description: Before anything is chosen, the verification custodian checks the evidence and mandate against what selection requires - that the evidence is current and the mandate bounds what the programme may take on. Defects are flagged for rejection or repair before the selection is made.
processes:task-eo-improve-verify-unpyvj.business_purpose: It exists so the portfolio is never chosen from stale evidence or beyond the mandate's reach.
processes:task-eo-improve-verify-unpyvj.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the evidence predating the last process change and flags the defect before any project is chosen.

processes:task-eo-improve-record-h8c667.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the sustainment trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. processes:task-eo-improve-record-h8c667.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the sustainment trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a benefits review would consult.
